note: City park campground run by the Hazelton City Park Board at Cottage St and Hazel Ave, east of Hwy 83 (distinct from the USACE Hazelton Recreation Area on Lake Oahe and private Badger Creek); tent space, playground, ballfield, picnic shelters and an enclosed shelter for rent, horseshoes and shuffleboard; cafe and grocery nearby. --Claude
